messages:
deploy-bot: Canary failed for release r2026.03.20-hotfix-tokenizer (eu-west1). 5xx spike on /generate from 14:12–14:14 UTC, aborting canary. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/abcd1234

sam_choi: saw the spike, looks like tokenizer edge-case with long prompt batching. Repro locally with curl + long prompt, getting OOM-ish errors from kernel.

liam: can we pin previous model variant for eu-west1 while we fix? we need quick rollback plan.

claire_pm: this impacts a handful of enterprise customers in EU with realtime chat. We should expedite approval for a hotfix deploy + pin. customers alerted in #customer-notify.

oncall_sre: suggested plan: 1) pin traffic to r2026.03.18-stable for eu-west1 2) rollback any partial canaries 3) deploy patched image to staging then promote. Approve?

eva: patch is ready (sha: f7c9a2b), includes tokenizer bounds check and smaller default batch size in runtime config. Ran unit + quick e2e on staging; looks good.

release_engineer: propose skipping full multi-zone canary due to impact, do a short 10-min canary on single node with circuit-breaker and increased sampling, then promote if green. Need approvals from SRE + Product.

sam_choi: request expedited approval: /approve-hotfix r2026.03.20-hotfix-tokenizer --reason "EU enterprise impact; pin and promote" --skip-multi-zone-canary

claire_pm: +1 from Product. Customers need the fix rolled out within the next 30–60m.

oncall_sre: +1 from SRE if we pin fallback and have rollback script ready. I triggered a preflight: `scripts/check-telemetry --since 15m` — looks stable now after abort.

deploy-bot: Approval check: product=approved by claire_pm, sre=approved by oncall_sre. Deploy gate: manual_approval required.

release_engineer: executing pin now: `infra traffic-pin --region eu-west1 --service inference --version r2026.03.18-stable`

deploy-bot: traffic-pin succeeded. 100% -> r2026.03.18-stable in eu-west1.

release_engineer: starting expedited deploy of patched image to canary node with reduced batch. Command: 
```
./deploy --env prod --region eu-west1 --image gcr/redwood/inference:f7c9a2b --canary-nodes 1 --circuit-breaker 60s
```

sam_choi: monitoring logs and latency now. tagging additional oncall for 15m watch.

oncall_sre: watching. set alert threshold to +10% latency and >1% 5xx.

deploy-bot: Canary healthy at +8m. no surge in 5xx, latency within SLO.

release_engineer: promoting to 100% (gradual over 5m). `./promote --region eu-west1 --to-version f7c9a2b --window 5m`

deploy-bot: Promote started. Will notify on completion.

claire_pm: filing release note: "Hotfix: tokenizer bounds check and safer batching — EU customers." Will update status page after full promote.

deploy-bot: Promote complete. Version f7c9a2b serving 100% in eu-west1. No regressions reported in first 15m.

eva: closing loop: PR merged, postmortem checklist item created. follow-up: add more unit tests for long prompt tokenization and add a telemetry regression alert.

sam_choi: thanks all, great coordination. :thumbsup:
